summary: Raised from the docs-site side while writing the 1.3.0 pages: the copy tells users to "hit Remove" for object removal and there is no Remove. Verified absent, not merely unfound - no remove: key in commandRegistry.js, models.js itself lists remove under deprecated/never wired, and grep for a Remove label across js/ returns only Remove Background (a different BiRefNet tool, which is the trap: a user hunting for Remove finds it and gets the inverse). The real path is mask -> inpaint -> EMPTY prompt, which inpaint.help already states correctly, so the ? guide and the Model Library tile contradict each other. Three sites: models.js:529 is the urgent one because it is live UI a user reads while deciding to install Klein, not a changelog; releaseNotes.js:49 and the 2026-07-30-v1.3.0.md mirror are changelogs and their correction is a recorded judgement call. Docs site already ships the correct procedure (Cubric-Studio-Docs 04a400b), so the fix is entirely app-side.
